Could be a conflict, yeah. He stated the weapon was working fine, then he installed realism and the compats and that’s when the issue started, but he has a decent sized modlist.

But while developing one of my own mods I found that Massivesoft does some very different things loading its weapons and components. It either implements some methods after PostDBLoad or pushes some work to the very end of of PostDBLoad. I never dug into it too deeply because it wasn’t causing serious issues for me, but I’d hypothesize that this could overwrite some realism changes, regardless of load order or compatibility patching using Fontaine’s integrated method. Lmk what you find when you look into it.

comments.author: Solid-Rhoads
comments.body_html:
Update: I was testing a bit myself while setting up a realism instance. Identified a few persisting issues.

My notes:

Massivesoft:

  • ✅ MCW’s — all seem to work (recoil may be buggy on a couple)
  • ✅ ISO Hemlocks — seem to work
  • ✅ DG56 — works
  • ✅ Tavor’s — seem good
  • ✅ QBZ 03 and 97 — both seem good
  • ✅ Jak 12 — seems good
  • ❌ Type 64 — all variants shoot straight down into the ground
  • ❌ ISO Subs — attempting to fire any variant causes a crash
  • ❌ ZLR Grau’s — locks player in place; floats next to you - broken

Choccy:

  • ✅ Striker — works
  • ❌ Choccy Type64 — also shoots down into the ground
  • ❌ Choccy Raffica — recoil bugged and shoots into the ground

All tested in the shooting range with default presets. Using just realism, the weapon mods, and the compatibility patches, no other mods. *edit: SPT 3.11.4 - fresh install, Realism 1.6.1 (default configs), most recent for other mods. SPT Developer profile.
I didn’t dig any further, just letting you know my results here.
